newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums hold, demand only for small lots.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums hold, demand only for small lots.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums held steady on Tuesday amid very thin trade with demand limited to small parcels, dealers said.
"Most requirements are for small amounts," said one trader who added that the steady prices reflected market illiquidity rather than any underlying strength.
Jet cargo premiums were unchanged at Feb IPE gas oil +$27 fob ARA. Barge premiums held at Feb IPE +$29/30, dealers said.
A 25,000 tonne Med cargo was expected to arrive in NWE this week with some barrels thought available for a two port discharge.
Interest for up to 6,000 tonnes was seen into the Thames, but it was not likely to be sourced from the Med cargo.

Shipping remains tight although there were signs that freight rates were starting to ease. Traders said the Med still had length particularly of non EC material which was having difficulty finding homes.
